# The Promptor by Blacure

> The Promptor by Blacure is an AI Music Prompt Studio that turns creative direction into production-ready song blueprints.

The Promptor helps producers, songwriters, and hobbyists shape genre, vocals, mood, topic, instruments, tempo, arrangement, and mix direction into a complete prompt for their AI music workflow.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing The Promptor by Blacure.
- [The Promptor](/app): Interactive prompt builder with genre, vocals, mood, instruments, tempo, and style controls.
